dimensions.evidenceA: An announced course changes in response to intercession.
dimensions.evidenceB: Divine constancy secures both judgment and preservation.
dimensions.label: Narrative response and covenant constancy

evidence.observation: The LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
Malachi grounds Jacob’s survival in the LORD’s statement, “I do not change.”

record.tension: The narrative describes a changed announced outcome, while the prophetic claim names God’s covenant constancy.
record.title: Does God relent or remain unchanged?
